name: Puerto-Princesa Subterranean River National Park
description: On Palawan's west coast, about 80 kilometres north of Puerto Princesa, this park shelters a river that flows through a limestone mountain in darkness and empties straight into the sea. Its lower stretch rises and falls with the tides. Visitors reach it by boat from the village of Sabang, then drift into the cave. Outside, forest covers the slopes from the peaks to the shore.
